verdict.rationale: Alacritty has no export feature. Its main user data, the configuration, is stored natively as plain TOML files, with support for importing additional files, so that data is already in an open, portable format. Nothing in the evidence describes exporting scrollback or session content beyond manual selection and copy. Missing for 10: a documented export or data-portability capability, evidence covering scrollback/session data, independent corroboration of migrating away.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Alacritty's configuration file uses the TOML format.
Imports are loaded in order, skipping all missing files, with the importing file being loaded last.
